title: A Day in the Life of an Artist

sentences.text: The sun shines through a small window.
She is in a tiny room.
It is full of colors and brushes.
She smiles and gets out of bed.
She puts on slippers and walks to her kitchen.
She looks at the people outside.
She thinks about her painting.'What to paint?' she thinks.
It will be a good painting.She finds her brushes and paints.
She puts them in her backpack.
She walks to the park.The park is busy.
She finds a place to paint.
She begins to paint.She paints a tree.
She makes the splash part of the painting.
Her painting is done.She looks at her painting.
She is ready to go home.She arrives home.
